clips.title: The story
paras: Wanted: "Hogger" is an Alliance bounty posted outside Goldshire for the head of a massive, savage gnoll chieftain. Hogger prowls the southwestern woods of Elwynn Forest and has violently thwarted every attempt by the local authorities to bring him down.

While Elwynn Forest struggles with banditry and kobold infestations, the gnoll tribes in the south have grown bolder and more organized under the brute leadership of Hogger. Towering over typical Riverpaw gnolls, Hogger has established camp near the Forest's Edge, ambushing travelers and overpowering the local militia patrols sent to subdue him.

With the Stormwind Army stretched thin and unable to spare regular forces to police the outskirts of the capital, Marshal Dughan took the unusual step of posting an open bounty on the beast. Taking down Hogger requires venture into deeply hostile gnoll territory, and his ferocity has earned him a reputation as the deadliest threat facing novice adventurers in Elwynn.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn. He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.
The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll. To earn the reward, bounty adventurers should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men. You have something to report about the beast?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!
Here you are, friend. And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
